topic_thesis: Technical analysis patterns like 'FTP4' are just modern-day horoscopes designed to make gambling look like a data-driven investment strategy.
strategic_angle: Expose the psychological trap of Pareidolia—the brain's tendency to see patterns in random noise—and reveal how trading 'gurus' use these arbitrary shapes to sell courses while 95% of retail F&O traders consistently lose capital.
key_statistic: 90% of retail traders lose money in F&O, yet 'pattern' courses continue to sell for ₹10,000+ per head.
target_emotion: Cynical realization and skepticism toward trading influencers.
pinned_comment_text: How much have you lost chasing 'magical' patterns that never actually work? Share your reality check below, or comment 'GUIDE' for our actual risk management checklist! 📉👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Use the hook 'Chart-ah paathu kashtapadaatheenga' (Don't suffer looking at charts). Focus on the 'Sutta Kadhai' (stolen/fake story) aspect of trading gurus. Use terms like 'Trading-la suthal' (dizziness/confusion in trading) and 'Kasu gaali' (money gone) to emphasize the loss of hard-earned middle-class savings.
source_signal: High retail interest in F&O trading despite consistent SEBI warnings on wealth erosion.
